# Happy Kingdom Travels — Bhutan Tour Packages

Happy Kingdom Travels is a Bhutan-based travel agency offering guided tour packages, custom itineraries, honeymoon trips, family holidays, and group tours across Bhutan.

## What We Offer

- [Bhutan Tour Packages](/bhutan-tour-packages) — 4N/5D to 9N/10D packages covering Paro, Thimphu, Punakha, Bumthang, and more
- [Custom Trip Builder](/customize-your-trip) — Personalised itineraries based on your preferences
- [Family Tour Packages](/family-tour-packages) — Kid-friendly Bhutan holidays with flexible schedules
- [Group Tour Packages](/group-tour-packages) — Affordable group departures to Bhutan
- [Travel Guide](/travel-guide) — Bhutan trip cost, visa requirements, best time to visit, how to reach Bhutan
- [Destinations](/destinations) — Detailed guides for Paro, Thimphu, Punakha, Bumthang, Haa Valley, and more

## Key Information

- Office: [Happy Kingdom Travels](/about), Siliguri, West Bengal, India
- Contact: [Phone and WhatsApp](/contact) — available for trip enquiries and bookings
- Blog: [Travel tips and guides](/blog) — latest Bhutan travel news, itineraries, and cultural insights
- Reviews: [Customer testimonials](/reviews) — verified reviews from past travellers

## How to Book

1. Browse [tour packages](/bhutan-tour-packages) or [build a custom trip](/customize-your-trip)
2. Fill in the [enquiry form](/contact) with your travel details
3. Our team will contact you with a personalised itinerary and pricing
4. Confirm your booking and get ready for your Bhutan adventure
